note: work/ is not under version control, so a batch cannot be shown as a diff in this repository.  What is recorded here is the auditable facts: the original digest (retrievable from the verified archive), the new digest, the measured metric movement, and the version-controlled test that carries the equivalence proof.

measurement_method.code_shape_metrics: comments AND string literals blanked in place (tokenize ranges; adjacency and line structure preserved) so a migration's own explanatory comment cannot inflate the metric that measures the migration
measurement_method.filename_metrics: comments blanked, string literals kept - progress.json and protected_files live in strings, so blanking strings would erase the thing being counted
measurement_method.why_this_matters: the first attempt at this measurement reported registry_shim unchanged and protected_files/refs up, purely because the migrated file's comment named the removed constructs
measurement_method.baseline: the pre-rewrite tree, with the original file read back out of the verified archive
measurement_method.docstring_note: a third scrub was needed for the filename metrics: a module docstring is a STRING token, so 'blank comments, keep strings' retained the migrated file's own prose mentioning protected_files.json, and the metric rose by one.  Docstrings are located with ast and blanked, otherwise ordinary string literals are kept.  The metric must be immune to comments AND docstrings; the documentation stays informative.

batches.scope_reason: chosen as the only standalone driver in its family: it is referenced by no patcher, so the batch exercises the full rewrite -> compile check -> CI -> equivalence -> inventory loop without touching a chain

what_was_replaced.assert status=='ready' and active_step==: expected_cursor (and a revision CAS the driver never had)
what_was_replaced.(W/'protected_files.json').write_text +: protected_manifest, verified at entry and before commit; nothing written to disk

advance_bounded_refs.expected: the replacement entry point itself appears

batches.metric_verdict: every hand-rolled metric fell by exactly the expected amount; the only increase is advance_bounded, the intended replacement

deletion_criteria_status.rotted_state_recorded: the driver asserted active_step==5/last_completed_step==4 of a project now completed at revision 561

batches.scope_reason: the five standalone members of the family: same shape (manifest, one step, no registry shim), none referenced by a patcher, so one recipe and one equivalence template cover them

drivers.note: keeps its two-step loop as successive bounded calls; the manifest derivation (policy digests plus two directory walks) is unchanged but handed to the contract instead of written to disk

batches.metric_verdict: every hand-rolled metric fell; the only increase is advance_bounded, exactly one per migrated driver

corrections.found_in: batch 2, before the batch was recorded
corrections.defect: the migrated drivers passed expected_cursor=(state.active_stage, state.active_subtask, state.source_step_id) taken from the state they had just read, and expected_revision=state.revision likewise.  The revision CAS therefore passed by construction, and the original precondition - 'the next step is N' - was silently deleted rather than moved.
corrections.why_it_was_invisible: cursor_of() returns (active_stage, active_subtask, source_step_id) and does not carry active_step at all, so the expectation had nowhere to go; and reading the revision to build the contract is exactly what makes a CAS vacuous.  The migration looked like it had expressed the precondition as an authorisation.
corrections.fix: the five drivers keep the original precondition verbatim as an explicit guard on the field it asserted (active_step, or active_subtask, plus status), refusing with a readable message; the contract then adds the revision CAS the original never had.  Batch 1's driver was corrected the same way.
corrections.regression_test: tests/test_gate_g4_driver_migration.py::test_a_read_then_pin_cursor_silently_drops_a_step_expectation demonstrates the hole (a read-then-pin contract advances a project the driver refused) and that the revision CAS is what remains real
corrections.severity: would have removed a guard from five drivers without any test failing, which is the exact failure mode this whole exercise exists to prevent

corrections.defect: metrics counted code shapes inside the migrated file's own comments, so registry_shim read unchanged and protected_files read higher
corrections.fix: code-shape metrics scrub comments and strings; filename metrics scrub comments and docstrings, keeping ordinary strings
corrections.regression_test: the metric script is stated in this record; each batch re-measures both sides with the same scrub
